findings.finding: TrackerTaskContext exposes only can_answer/can_confirm and waiting_reason; no structured confirmation prerequisite status/routing-policy projection. Consumer uses explicit reason or identifies missing projection.
TrackerAnswer ACK confirms saved answer; DTO exposes no PM delivery/consumption receipt. UI reports delivery unconfirmed independently.
